text.en: Visitors enthusiastically praise team members including Susan, Winston, and Kris for their welcoming, attentive approach. Reviewers note that staff take time to answer detailed questions, assist with dog tag engraving, and offer practical guidance on shedding and pet nutrition, making each shopping trip memorable.

Clients describe the West Broadway boutique as bright, tidy, and thoroughly stocked with premium pet foods and supplies. Shoppers appreciate finding quality freeze-dried raw formulas, wholesome treats, and daily essentials conveniently located in Kitsilano, highlighting the pleasant, uncluttered retail atmosphere.

Pet owners appreciate that dogs are greeted warmly with treats upon arrival, with several noting their companions eagerly pull them into the store. Reviewers also highlight successful dietary solutions recommended by staff that resolved persistent skin irritation for cats and helped manage shedding in large dogs.

q.en: Does Pet Planet on West Broadway offer pet grooming services?

a.en: Yes, clients report excellent grooming experiences with groomer Winston, who handles nail trims, bath blowouts, and full haircuts.

q.en: Are dogs welcome inside the West Broadway shop?

a.en: Yes, leashed dogs are warmly welcomed by staff members and frequently receive complimentary treats during their visit.

q.en: Does the store stock raw and freeze-dried pet foods?

a.en: Yes, the store carries a wide variety of fresh, raw, and freeze-dried pet food formulas alongside healthy supplements and treats.

q.en: Can customers engrave pet identification tags in store?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that staff are ready to assist with creating custom engraved identification tags on site.
